newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea to supply one trillion won in repos.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea to supply one trillion won in repos.

text.p: The Bank of Korea said it would begin supplying one trillion won to the nation's banking system through repurchase agreements on Friday.

The central bank said the money supply was aimed at easing liquidity in the short-term money market which had dried up due to a delay in the supply of 900 billion won from the state budget to the education ministry.
"Banks are feeling some difficulty in meeting the central bank's reserve requirements," said a bank official.
